post.description:
Wrong role or unknown account gets the same message as a wrong password
(no account probing). Five failures lock the account for 15 minutes.

get.description:
The caller's token claims plus the portal profile (id, language) the
web app stores after sign-in. Used after the Keycloak redirect.
Public sign-in settings for the web app (no secrets).

One payload for the student home page, built from rows (snapshots, skill
scores, sessions, sprint tasks, events, badges).
Short-lived signed URL (presigned URL in production object storage).
Screen 14: one flag with its history of actions (own batches only; else 404).
Screen 15 overview for one child (defaults to the first linked child).
Screen 44 list: newest first, filter by kind or unread, paged with a created_at cursor.

post.description:
Queue Teams meeting creation for upcoming sessions and attendance pulls
for ended ones (the Celery beat runs the same for every college).
The trainer plays the client: a change request adds a card to To Do.

GitHub App webhook: pull_request opened -> Code Review; merged -> Done;
workflow_run completed -> build status.
One-to-one threads obey the messaging policy at the API, not just in the UI.

get.description:
Messages of one thread. lang=ta|en returns each message translated
(cached); the original always travels with it. Opening marks incoming read.

post.description:
Browser-lab heartbeat. Authenticated by a token scoped to one session, so it also works
from navigator.sendBeacon (text/plain body) when the tab closes.

get.description: Live lab sessions in the trainer's batches (no workspace contents, only who, which lab and for how long).

delete.description: The student can delete their own chat (usage counts stay: they are metering, not content).
